beats.say: This box lets a tiny signal switch a huge load, with a satisfying click.
A relay is an electromagnet and a switch in one box. Power the coil, and its magnetic field pulls the switch closed.
The coil side needs only a small current. The switch side can carry a big one, and the two never touch electrically.
That's how a tiny five volt microcontroller can safely switch a mains appliance.
Next time: the motor. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
